title: If You Don't Have the Time To Read Epic Snarky Writing on Fiduciary Duty, Here is The Summary In Video in Under 4 Minutes
subtitle: I get it. You are lazy. Me too.
body_html:
I know, I talk about fiduciary duty a lot. Because it matters a lot. I just wrote an epic thing that took months to complete about pharmacy benefit managers. But you're probably not gonna read it. So here's a video. It's under four minutes. And it basically, accomplished the same thing. Please subscribe to The Frontier Psychiatrists newsletter—it is written by me, Owen Muir. I am a psychiatrist. This is not a newsletter Only about Psychiatry. It is about whatever I want to write that day. It’s about… about daily?1 Compared to other newsletters, the growth on this and the engagement is unf$cking believable2, so you're just going have to follow along and have faith that even though I have no idea what I'm doing, it is doing something, and that is a thing that works, and I thank you for your readership.

The video was edited by me, and improvised by me, and I had some help from a friend who is awesome.

You should subscribe. I put a lot of work into this. I feel validated when you subscribe. I feel especially validated when you share the work. You don't have to pay anything. You can just have to be an evangelical. Thank you for supporting the cause.
